{"notes": [{"note_type": "ID consult note", "author_role": "Infectious Diseases", "days_before_request": 1, "body": "(copied fwd from 1/28): T 38.2 HR 97 BP 104/62 RR 18. Plan: cont ceftriaxone 1g IV q24h for UTI, f/u cx, cautious IVF, d/c foley when able. -- NOTE: above vitals/plan are stale, superseded below --

84F, ESRD on HD TTS (Synthetic Dialysis Unit East), wt 55.4 kg. Adm w/ dysuria + suprapubic pain -> UTI. On ceftriaxone since 1/28, now >72h w/ no clinical improvement: persistent suprapubic discomfort, CRP 80 (unchanged), WBC 7.6. Urine cx 1/30: E. coli, ESBL. Susc: ceftriaxone R, cefepime R, cipro R, pip-tazo I, ertapenem S, meropenem S. Blood cx 1/25 no growth.

Hemodynamically stable this entire admission: MAPs mid-70s, no vasoactive support at any point, lactate 1.0, no signs of shock, not septic appearing today. Afebrile T 36.9, HR 82, BP 128/70.

Foley removed 1/29, voiding, bladder scan residual minimal -- source control achieved.

Allergies: chart lists vancomycin (red man, moderate). Pt separately reports PCN allergy w/ ANAPHYLAXIS (lip/tongue swelling, hospitalized yrs ago) -- NOT on the EHR allergy list; asked pharmacy + nursing to add. Pip-tazo not an option (only I result, plus this hx).

Plan: meropenem 1000 mg IV q24h, infuse after HD on dialysis days. Restricted-abx exception form submitted. f/u CRP and sx; repeat urine cx only if sx persist."}], "justification": "ESBL E. coli UTI failing >72h of ceftriaxone (ongoing suprapubic pain, CRP 80 unchanged). Isolate R to ceftriaxone/cefepime/cipro; pip-tazo only intermediate and pt reports an anaphylactic penicillin allergy not yet on the chart list. Source is controlled (foley removed) and pt is hemodynamically stable, never required pressors. Meropenem susceptible; 1 g IV q24h dosed for HD, to run post-dialysis."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Hospitalist progress note", "author_role": "MD", "days_before_request": 4, "body": "80F w/ CKD 3a (baseline Cr ~1.6) p/w fever 38.6 at rehab + 2d malaise. T 38.2, HR 96, BP 132/78 (MAP 96), RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. WBC 9.9, CRP 224, lactate 1.7. SIRS +; source unclear, CXR neg per rad, UA + urine cx to be collected, blood cx ordered, still pending collection. Started empiric vanc — PCN allergy (angioedema, severe) limits beta-lactam options; also latex contact dermatitis (mild), non-latex supplies flagged. Hemodynamically stable: no vasopressors at any point this admission, MAPs >70 on maintenance IVF alone, no signs of shock, not septic-appearing on exam. Record review: no prior MRSA, VRE, ESBL, or CRE infection or colonization; no MDRO flag in chart. A/P: cont vanc per pharmacy w/ troughs; f/u cx once sent. K 5.8 — patiromer given, recheck AM, low-K diet. Hgb 9.6 stable, no transfusion. Sevelamer 800 mg w/ meals cont; PTH 214, will trend. Renal diet education done w/ daughter. Pt c/o transport issues to outpatient labs — daughter works days, shuttle unreliable; case mgmt aware."}, {"note_type": "Nephrology consult note", "author_role": "MD", "days_before_request": 1, "body": "Consulted for CKD 3a w/ vanc dosing question. eGFR 50, Cr 1.68 at baseline. T 37.8, BP 126/70 (MAP 89), HR 88. Not on any vasoactive agents, no hypotension this admission, no pressor support — perfusing well on her own. Alert, joking w/ daughter at bedside; does not appear toxic. Fever w/ CRP 224 under workup; empiric vanc 1000 mg IV q8h per primary team, indication fever/empiric MRSA coverage pending cultures (none back yet, collection in progress). Vanc trough 18.7 — suggested interval recheck, may space to q12h if repeat trough stays high; defer to ASP. Confirmed w/ pt + outside chart: no previous MDRO, no MRSA/VRE/ESBL/CRE hx before this illness. Other: K improved 5.8 -> 5.4 s/p patiromer; PO4 4.9, binder adherence reviewed (takes w/ dinner only, counseled to take w/ all meals); anemia stable, ESA on hold; no indication for dialysis or AV access at current GFR. Family meeting planned Thurs re: goals of care should renal fcn decline; transportation for f/u remains a barrier, SW involved. Rec: cont vanc, daily SCr/K, repeat trough before 4th dose."}], "justification": "Febrile with CRP 224, needs empiric MRSA coverage while cultures are pending collection. Severe penicillin allergy (angioedema) limits beta-lactam alternatives. No prior MDRO history; hemodynamically stable without pressors but source workup ongoing in a CKD patient."}

{"septic_shock":{"value":false,"evidence":"no vasopressors at any point this admission, MAPs >70 on maintenance IVF alone, no signs of shock"},"hemodynamic_instability":{"value":false,"evidence":"hemodynamically stable without pressors"},"prior_mdro_colonization":{"value":false,"evidence":"no previous MDRO, no MRSA/VRE/ESBL/CRE hx before this illness"}}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Nephrology Consult Note", "author_role": "Nephrology Fellow", "days_before_request": 6, "body": "Nephrology consulted for Cr 2.0 on CKD 3a in setting of febrile illness.

HPI: 42M (98.9 kg) admitted 1/25 w/ fevers to 38.8 and dysuria x3d. Denies nausea, vomiting, rash, new meds. NKDA. Lives w/ wife, works warehouse, no tobacco.

Vitals: T 38.2, HR 94, BP 130/76, MAP 94, RR 16, SpO2 98% RA. Gen: febrile, NAD. CV RRR, ext warm and well perfused, cap refill <2 sec, trace LE edema.

Labs: Cr 2.0 (baseline ~1.6), eGFR 48, K 3.9, WBC 12.4, Hgb 8.5 (pt states chronic). UA w/ pyuria, urine cx sent this AM.

A/P:
1. Mild AKI on CKD 3a, likely prerenal d/t fever/poor PO intake — isotonic fluids, avoid NSAIDs/contrast, trend Cr qAM.
2. Febrile UTI — empiric ceftriaxone per ED, will tailor to cx.
3. Anemia, chronic-appearing, stable, no signs bleeding.

Pt hemodynamically stable — MAP > 70 since arrival, no hypotension, no vasopressor requirement. Will f/u."}, {"note_type": "Progress Note", "author_role": "Internal Medicine Resident", "days_before_request": 3, "body": "(copied fwd from 1/27: T 37.2, HR 82, BP 128/76. Plan: if afebrile x48h, transition to PO abx, d/c IV, ambulate w/ PT.)
Above vitals/plan stale — pt spiked T 38.5 overnight; PO transition superseded, see below.

S: c/o continued fevers, dysuria improving. Denies chills, SOB, CP, dizziness on standing. Appetite fair, wife at bedside.

O: T 38.5, HR 97, BP 122/70, MAP 87, RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. Warm/dry. PIV L forearm clean.
Urine cx 1/26: Enterococcus faecalis — ampicillin S, vanc S. Ceftriaxone narrowed to IV ampicillin 1/27 per sensitivities. Blood cx x2 drawn 1/28, results pending.
WBC 13.6 (up from 12.4), CRP 60, Cr 2.0 stable, eGFR 48, K 3.9.

A/P: persistent fever despite culture-directed ampicillin — source not fully explained; blood cx pending, ID paged. Hemodynamically stable, no pressors, no signs of shock. Continue low-rate IVF, encourage PO. f/u cx and temp curve."}, {"note_type": "ID Consult Note", "author_role": "Infectious Diseases Attending", "days_before_request": 0, "body": "ID consult for persistent fever.

42M, 98.9 kg, CKD 3a (Cr 2.0, eGFR 48), NKDA. Admitted 1/25 w/ febrile UTI; urine cx 1/26 grew E. faecalis (ampicillin S, vanc S), on IV ampicillin since 1/27. Fevers persist — Tmax 38.9 overnight — w/ WBC 13.6, CRP 60. Blood cx still pending.

Exam: T 38.6, HR 95, BP 124/72, MAP 89, SpO2 98% RA. Alert, pleasant, no rigors at bedside. PIV only, no CVC, no tunneled line. Lungs CTA, abdomen soft, mild suprapubic tenderness improving. No rash.

A/P:
1. Persistent fever on appropriate rx for E. faecalis UTI — concern for second source not covered by ampicillin; awaiting blood cx.
2. Recommend empiric vancomycin 1000 mg IV q24h (conservative for eGFR 48/wt, follow levels). First dose given 1/31 evening under restricted-abx protocol; pre-dose level 13.0 this AM — continue current regimen, recheck level w/ next dose. Exception form filed today.
3. Pt is not in septic shock: normotensive throughout admission, MAP consistently > 65, off vasopressors, lactate 0.9. No ICU transfer warranted at this time.
4. Continue ampicillin; tailor all abx once blood cx finalize.

Will f/u daily."}], "justification": "Fever and rising WBC persist despite 5 days of culture-directed IV ampicillin for E. faecalis UTI; blood cultures still pending. Requesting empiric vancomycin for MRSA coverage per form indication while workup continues. Pt is hemodynamically stable — normotensive, no vasopressors, no shock. Dose renally adjusted (eGFR 48, 98.9 kg) w/ level monitoring."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "ID consult follow-up", "author_role": "Infectious Diseases attending", "days_before_request": 3, "body": "ID f/u — 65M, 101.9 kg, CKD 3a, admitted w/ MSSA bacteremia (blood cx 2/27; oxacillin S, cefazolin S, vanc S). On cefazolin since 2/28, now day 4. Allergy list re-reviewed w/ pt at bedside: vanc -> red man (moderate), codeine -> n/v. NO penicillin allergy and no beta-lactam allergy of any kind — has tolerated PCN and cephalosporins in the past, so cefazolin appropriate and no need to avoid the class.

Trending well: afebrile x48h, WBC 13.2 -> 11.4, CRP 121 -> 84. Repeat blood cx drawn 3/3: no growth to date. Hemodynamically stable throughout this entire admission — MAPs mid-70s on RA, lactate 1.4, has not required vasopressors at any point, no signs of shock. Denies chills, CP, SOB. Appetite improving, ambulating w/ PT.

Plan: cont cefazolin (renally dosed, eGFR ~53), f/u cx, duration TBD.

[leftover template — bed 14, NOT this pt]: on linezolid for VRE UTI, CBC Mon/Thu to watch plt."}, {"note_type": "Nephrology progress note", "author_role": "Nephrology resident", "days_before_request": 0, "body": "Nephrology progress note — 65M w/ CKD 3a (baseline Cr ~1.6-1.7), here w/ MSSA bacteremia, now d7 of cefazolin w/ clear clinical improvement. Vitals: T 36.9, HR 82, BP 128/74 (MAP 92), RA. Not septic appearing, no pressors this stay, no shock. Labs AM: Cr 1.71 (eGFR 53, at baseline), K 4.7, Hgb 8.5 stable, WBC 10.9, CRP 68 downtrending, lactate 1.4. UOP adequate, no edema on exam, no indication for HD; pt remains non-dialysis.

c/o mild fatigue only; denies fevers, CP, SOB, n/v. (copy-forward: pt resting comfortably in bed, denies acute complaints, appetite fair.)

Allergies per chart: vanc (red man), codeine (nausea); no PCN/beta-lactam allergy.

Aware meropenem exception form submitted today citing broad-spectrum gram-negative coverage — deferred to ID/ASP on necessity; from renal side 1g q8h reasonable at current eGFR w/ Cr/K monitoring. Will continue to trend renal fn."}], "justification": "MSSA bacteremia currently improving on cefazolin d7, follow-up cx 3/3 no growth; pt hemodynamically stable, no pressors this admission. Vanc listed as allergy (red man); no penicillin/beta-lactam allergy on file. Requesting meropenem 1g IV q8h for broad-spectrum gram-negative coverage per form; renal function supports dosing (eGFR 53)."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Infectious Diseases progress note", "author_role": "ID attending", "days_before_request": 1, "body": "ID f/u. 73F, 66.8 kg, ESRD (CKD 5D) on HD TTS at Synthetic Dialysis Unit East, admitted w/ pneumonia. NKDA.

(copied fwd from 2/14) Vitals: T 37.1, HR 88, BP 132/74, RR 16, SpO2 94% RA. A/P: CAP — empiric vanc, pharmacy to dose, redose post-HD; f/u sputum cx; f/u Monday.

Above vitals/plan are stale and superseded as of today. Now: T 38.6, HR 102, BP 118/62, RR 22, SpO2 91% on 2L NC. Pt c/o productive cough, worse since admission. CXR: RLL consolidation, more confluent than prior film. Sputum cx 2/17: Enterococcus faecium (VRE) — vanc R, amp R, linezolid S, dapto S. Blood cx 2/10 no growth; not bacteremic. Despite therapeutic vanc troughs (~18-20) x 4 days, pt clinically worsening: persistent fevers, rising O2 requirement, CRP up to 164 from 110 earlier this wk. WBC 9.4, lactate 1.3. Not septic, no signs of shock. Cr 11.05, eGFR 8, K 5.7 — dialyzing today per schedule. CK 181 baseline; will trend weekly on dapto.

A/P: VRE pneumonia, failing vancomycin.
1) D/c vanc today.
2) Request daptomycin 750 mg IV post-HD — restricted abx exception form submitted.
3) Repeat CXR in 48h, f/u cx.
4) Continue HD TTS; renally dose all meds."}], "justification": "VRE pneumonia: sputum grew E. faecium, vanc R, amp R, dapto S. Pt failing vancomycin — ongoing fevers, worsening RLL infiltrate, rising O2 need despite therapeutic troughs x 4 days. Blood cx negative, no bacteremia. Request daptomycin 750 mg IV post-HD (HD TTS)."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Nephrology / HD Treatment Note", "author_role": "Nephrology fellow", "days_before_request": 0, "body": "HD unit, Synthetic Kidney Clinic North — 78M ESKD on HD MWF via L IJ tunneled cath, wt 84.4 kg. Arrived for scheduled session c/o chills/rigors since last night, denies cough, dysuria, CP, diarrhea. Access site clean, no erythema, tenderness, or drainage. Tmax 38.7 pre-HD, now 38.4, HR 102, RR 18, SpO2 96% RA. Pre-HD BP 102/64; intradialytic hypotension mid-run, SBP down to 84, MAP ~62 — UF reduced, 500 mL NS bolused, session cut ~45 min short. Awake/alert, perfusing well, no pressors needed, not in shock; lactate 1.6. Post-HD BP still soft 88/55, will trend. Pt ate lunch, wants the room warmer, asking about parking validation (per routine).
Labs: WBC 23.7 (up from ~14 two wks ago), CRP 249, K 4.1, Cr 12.93, Hgb 10.0. Blood cx drawn 2/24 — no growth to date, bottles still incubating.
Hx notable: +MRSA nares swab 2024 documented at prior admission; no known VRE/ESBL/CRE. Allergies: PCN (angioedema, severe), SMX-TMP (rash, moderate).
[copy-forward fragment — bed 9, NOT this pt, disregard]: POD2 s/p R knee arthroplasty, ambulating x2 w/ PT, pain controlled on po oxycodone, d/c planning underway.
Plan: empiric vanc 1000 mg IV post-HD today via restricted-abx exception pending cx; continue temp curve, strict BP monitoring next session; f/u cx. — fellow, paged attending"}], "justification": "Empiric MRSA coverage: HD pt febrile to 38.7 during today's run w/ intradialytic hypotension, WBC 23.7, CRP 249, tunneled catheter in place and prior +MRSA nares (2024) — concern for catheter-related MRSA bacteremia. Severe PCN allergy (angioedema) precludes beta-lactam empiricism. Blood cx 2/24 no growth to date, still pending; requesting vanc 1000 mg IV post-HD w/ levels to guide redosing."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Progress Note", "author_role": "Internal Medicine Resident", "days_before_request": 5, "body": "1/27 progress: 42M w/ CKD 3a admitted 1/26 w/ fever to 38.7 at home + dysuria x3d. Now T 38.2, HR 101, BP 124/72 (MAP 89), RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. Warm, well perfused, no vasopressors, no signs of shock. Lactate 0.9. WBC 13.6, CRP 60, Cr 2.0 (near baseline per prior labs), K 3.9, Hgb 8.5 stable. UA +LE; urine cx from 1/26 growing E. faecalis, amp S / vanc S per micro. Blood cx x2 drawn, pending. Pt voiding fine, eating, denies CP/cough. c/o poor sleep d/t roommate snoring. A/P: febrile UTI vs early pyelo — start empiric vanc + ceftriaxone this AM, tailor once cx finalize. IVF 75/hr. NKDA. Recheck BMP in AM; nephro consulted for abx dosing w/ CKD. f/u blood cx."}, {"note_type": "Nephrology Consult Note", "author_role": "Nephrology Fellow", "days_before_request": 3, "body": "Nephro consult 1/29 — asked re: abx dosing in CKD. 42M, 98.9 kg, CKD 3a (baseline Cr ~1.7-1.8, eGFR ~48), Cr now 2.0 and stable, UOP adequate, no indication for HD at this time. On vanc 1g IV q24h (started 1/28) + ceftriaxone for febrile UTI; urine cx E. faecalis, amp/vanc S. Remains hemodynamically stable: BP 128/76, MAP 93, off pressors since arrival, lactate 0.9 on last check. No edema, lungs CTA, JVP not elevated. Pt ambulating w/ PT, watching the game, in good spirits. Recs: cont vanc 1000 mg IV q24h, draw trough pre-4th dose (1/31 AM); given stable renal fcn current regimen reasonable, adjust per level. Recheck Cr q48h, avoid NSAIDs/contrast, continue gentle IVF. NKDA. Recs discussed w/ primary team; will f/u trough result."}, {"note_type": "Progress Note", "author_role": "Hospitalist Attending", "days_before_request": 0, "body": "2/1 progress: (copied fwd from 1/27) Vitals: T 38.2, HR 101, BP 124/72 MAP 89, RR 18, SpO2 97% RA. Plan: blood cx x2, empiric abx pending cx, IVF 75/hr. — end copied block. Update 2/1 (supersedes copied vitals/plan above): T 37.9 this AM after 38.3 spike overnight, HR 88, BP 132/80 (MAP 97) on RA. Remains off pressors, no hypoperfusion, no signs of shock; lactate not repeated given stability. Vanc trough 1/31 = 13.0 on 1g q24h; Cr 2.0, eGFR 48, K 3.9, Hgb 8.5 stable, no transfusion. Blood cx still pending. Urine cx E. faecalis amp S — de-escalation discussed at rounds, but pt still spiking and team prefers to hold current coverage until blood cx final. Restricted-abx exception form submitted today to continue vanc. Pt ate breakfast, asks re: discharge — likely a few more days. NKDA."}], "justification": "42M w/ fever and leukocytosis (WBC 13.6, CRP 60), likely urinary source; urine cx grew E. faecalis (amp/vanc S) but pt keeps spiking and blood cx are still pending, so I want empiric gram-positive coverage continued until cultures finalize. Stable on 1g q24h w/ trough 13 and eGFR 48, no pressors, renal fcn steady — will recheck level and Cr. Plan to de-escalate to ampicillin once blood cx come back final."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Progress note", "author_role": "Hospitalist, Hospital Medicine", "days_before_request": 5, "body": "54M w/ CKD4 (baseline Cr ~3.5-4, no HD) p/w L plantar foot ulcer w/ spreading cellulitis x3d, worsening erythema/pain. Denies cough, sputum, SOB, pleurisy; no fevers at home. Vitals: T 37.8, HR 96, BP 128/74, RR 16, SpO2 97% RA. Exam: L plantar ulcer ~2 cm w/ purulence, erythema to mid-foot, +tender, pedal pulses 2+. Lungs CTA bilat, no crackles/wheeze — process localized to foot wound; no pulmonary source identified. Labs: WBC 8.0, CRP 129, lactate 1.7, K 5.3, Hgb 10.5, Cr 4.49 (eGFR 21). Blood cx 2/18 no growth. Wound cx + MRSA nares swab sent, pending. NKDA per EHR allergy table. Started cefazolin renally dosed; ID consulted for broader gram-pos coverage. IVF conservative d/t CKD. Copy-forward: pt c/o poor sleep d/t hallway noise, appetite fair, requests eggs for breakfast. [carryover template — rm 14, NOT this pt, disregard]: linezolid 600 q12h; TID IOP checks; pacemaker interrogation Thurs."}, {"note_type": "Nephrology consult note", "author_role": "Nephrology", "days_before_request": 1, "body": "F/u for renal dosing recs. 54M CKD4, not on dialysis, Cr 4.49/eGFR 21 (near baseline). ID recommends daptomycin 650 mg IV q48h for MRSA-risk LLE cellulitis s/p foot ulcer; agree q48h appropriate w/ eGFR <30. Baseline CK 240 — trend CK + Cr 2-3x/wk, counsel pt to report myalgias, hold for CK rise. K 5.3 — recheck AM, cont low-K diet. No pulm involvement per primary team; source remains foot wound. Blood cx 2/18 no growth. NKDA. Hgb 10.5 stable, no ESA change. Will f/u culture data; f/u w/ ID re: duration."}], "justification": "Non-pulmonary gram-positive source: L plantar foot ulcer w/ surrounding cellulitis, MRSA risk (wound cx and MRSA nares pending; blood cx 2/18 no growth). Requesting daptomycin for bactericidal gram-positive/MRSA activity — 650 mg (~7 mg/kg) IV q48h renally dosed for eGFR 21 / Cr 4.49, pt not on HD. Baseline CK 240; will trend CK and renal function and stop for CK rise or myalgias. NKDA per EHR."}

{"notes": [{"note_type": "Hospitalist progress note", "author_role": "Hospitalist", "days_before_request": 3, "body": "2/26 — 50M, 96.9 kg, CKD 3a (baseline Cr ~1.6-1.7, follows Synthetic Dialysis Unit East), admitted 2/24 w/ fevers, rigors, dysuria. Blood cx 2/24 + S. aureus (MSSA) — on cefazolin 2g IV q8h, repeat blood cx pending. Prior urine cx 2/20 grew E. faecalis (amp S, vanc S) — held directed tx d/t amox allergy hx, repeat urine cx sent 2/26, pending. Vitals: T 37.4, HR 84, BP 131/76, RR 16, SpO2 98% RA. Hemodynamically stable — has not required vasopressors at any point this admission, MAPs 80s-90s w/o pressor support, lactate 0.8, no signs of shock. Voiding fine, no retention. PMH: HTN, CKD 3a; remote C. diff colitis (2021) treated w/ PO vanc, resolved, no recurrence since. Allg: amoxicillin (itching, mild), cephalexin (rash, mild). Labs: WBC 12.4, Cr 1.72 (eGFR 50), K 4.9, Hgb 8.9, CRP pending. CT A/P w/o contrast: 7 mm L proximal ureteral stone w/ moderate hydronephrosis; urology consulted, ureteral stent planned 3/2 — infected source not yet controlled. Cont cefazolin, IVF conservative given CKD, f/u urine cx."}, {"note_type": "Infectious Diseases consult note", "author_role": "ID physician", "days_before_request": 1, "body": "ID consult 2/28 — 50M w/ MSSA bacteremia (2/24) on cefazolin 2g q8h + ESBL E. coli UTI. Urine cx 2/27: E. coli ESBL — ceftriaxone R, cefepime R, cipro R; pip-tazo S, ertapenem S, meropenem S. Started pip-tazo 3.375g IV q8h evening 2/27 (renal dose, eGFR 50). Plan: continue TZP x48h then reassess; team placing restricted-abx exception request for meropenem given ESBL; de-escalate per cx once source controlled. D/c anc之后? Anc: renal dose all abx per eGFR 50, f/u repeat cx results."}], "justification": "ESBL E. coli UTI (CTX R, FEP R, cip R) w/ obstructing L ureteral stone — source control still pending, urology stent planned 3/2.
